title: intro
body: You: The village elder wants to see me. I should find their house here in the village.

title: npcHouse
body:
<<if $quest == 0>>
Elder Wren: Ah, there you are. Thank you for coming.
Elder Wren: A stranger has been camping on the beach for days now.
Elder Wren: Could you go and ask them what brings them to Saltford? The beach road starts at the south gate.
<<set $quest = 1>>

[[Who is the stranger?|npcHouseMuukalainen]]
[[I'll go now|npcHouseHyvasti]]
<<elseif $quest == 1>>
Elder Wren: Have you spoken with the stranger yet? The beach road starts at the south gate.
<<elseif $quest == 2>>
Elder Wren: You're back! What did the stranger say?
You: Their name is Marlow. They're a mapmaker drawing a map of the coast.
Elder Wren: A mapmaker! What a relief. Thank you for finding out.
<<set $quest = 3>>
<<else>>
Elder Wren: Thank you again. Saltford can rest easy now.

[[Ask about the village|npcHouseKyla]]
[[Say goodbye|npcHouseHyvasti]]
<<end>>

title: npcHouseMuukalainen
body:
Elder Wren: I wish I knew. They arrived a few days ago and set up camp by the water.
Elder Wren: They seem harmless but I would like to know what they are doing here.

[[I'll go now|npcHouseHyvasti]]

title: npcHouseKyla
body:
Elder Wren: Saltford is a quiet fishing village. Most of us have lived by the sea all our lives.
Elder Wren: The road through the south gate leads down to the beach.

[[Say goodbye|npcHouseHyvasti]]

title: npcBeach
body:
<<if $quest == 0>>
Stranger: Hello there. The sea breeze is lovely today.
<<elseif $quest == 1>>
Stranger: Oh, the elder sent you? I should have come to introduce myself.
Marlow: My name is Marlow. I'm a mapmaker and I'm drawing a map of this coast.
Marlow: Tell your elder I mean no harm. I'll be on my way once the map is finished.
<<set $quest = 2>>
<<elseif $quest == 2>>
Marlow: Did you tell your elder about me?
<<else>>
Marlow: Thank you for speaking to your elder for me. The map is coming along nicely.
<<end>>
